summary.zh: 先备加油与护盾，让简持续站场；有实际黄光时才加入萨霍夫跳招架合轴。
summary.en: Prepare Cheer On and the shield, then sustain Jane’s field time. Add Salchow-to-parry overlap only on a real cue.

conditions.zh: 站位循环为简→赛斯→露西，保证赛斯上一位是简；三人整体轮转等价。
conditions.en: Use the cyclic order Jane → Seth → Lucy so Seth’s previous slot is Jane; rotating all three slots is equivalent.

conditions.zh: 这是一支持续强击队，不预设固定失衡周期；露西额外能力不触发。
conditions.en: This is sustained Assault, without an assumed Stun cycle. Lucy’s Additional Ability is inactive.

conditions.zh: 参考1.1作者手法，资源及影画按固定3.3资料复核；旧共享终结技与固定伤害数字不沿用。
conditions.en: The author’s 1.1 technique is checked against fixed 3.3 mechanics; old shared-Ultimate assumptions and fixed damage numbers are excluded.

label.zh: 小橙子 · 简队伍与操作（1.1）
小橙子 · 赛斯支援衔接（1.1）

objective.zh: 先备增益，再把护盾交给简。
objective.en: Prepare buffs, then give Jane the shield.

input.zh: 能量足够时点按或长按强化特殊技。
input.en: With enough energy, tap or hold EX Special.

trigger.zh: 加油尚未建立或需要刷新；真实能量足够。
trigger.en: Cheer On is absent or needs refreshing, and energy is sufficient.

complete.zh: 确认小猪爆炸已经施加加油；需要快支时还要实际命中敌人。
complete.en: Confirm the boar explosion applied Cheer On. A Quick Assist also requires an actual enemy hit.

reason.zh: 全队加攻先于简的输出；本队露西额外能力不生效，不能计入小猪双暴继承。
reason.en: Prepare team ATK before Jane attacks. Lucy’s Additional Ability is inactive here; do not assume boar CRIT inheritance.

fallback.zh: 没有能量时先用简补资源；普通特殊技召猪不等于已获得加油。
fallback.en: Without energy, build resources with Jane. Summoning boars with normal Special does not establish Cheer On.

signal.zh: 先普通换赛斯准备护盾；不把这次换人当成露西快支。
signal.en: Switch normally to Seth for shield setup; this switch is not Lucy’s Quick Assist.

input.zh: 能量足够时长按强化特殊技，完成蓄力攻击。
input.en: With enough energy, hold EX Special and complete its charged attack.

trigger.zh: 意气不足75%；已有足量意气时可跳过本步。
trigger.en: Resolve is below 75%. Skip when enough Resolve is already available.

complete.zh: 按实际意气确认达到75%，不要把普通特殊技当成强化特殊技。
complete.en: Check that actual Resolve reached 75%; a normal Special is not an EX.

reason.zh: 为下一步强化长普准备资源，护盾最终仍要通过对应支援给简。
reason.en: Prepare the held Basic; Jane still needs the matching assist entry to receive her shield.

fallback.zh: 无能量且意气不足，等待真实可招架的黄光，用招架后支援突击支援简；不要空按长普。
fallback.en: With insufficient energy and Resolve, use a real Defensive Assist opportunity and its follow-up to assist Jane; do not force the held Basic.

title.zh: 终结一击命中，提示上一位简
title.en: Land the finisher to prompt previous-slot Jane

input.zh: 意气至少75%时长按普通攻击。
input.en: Hold Basic with at least 75% Resolve.

trigger.zh: 意气足够且目标可命中。
trigger.en: Enough Resolve and a hittable target.

complete.zh: 终结一击确实命中，出现上一位简的快速支援提示。
complete.en: The finisher actually hits and the previous-slot Jane Quick Assist prompt appears.

reason.zh: 本队简紧邻赛斯之前；必须走对应快支，普通切回不会替代护盾触发。
reason.en: Jane occupies Seth’s previous slot. Respond to this Quick Assist; an ordinary switch does not trigger the shield.

fallback.zh: 漏掉命中或没有提示，重新检查资源；不要假定简已获得盾。
fallback.en: After a miss or absent prompt, recheck resources; Jane is not assumed to have the shield.

signal.zh: 出现简的快支提示后再接简。
signal.en: Take Jane’s actual Quick Assist prompt.

title.zh: 简快支入场，检查匪石之盾
title.en: Jane Quick Assist: verify Shield of Firm Resolve

input.zh: 按赛斯触发的对应快速支援提示入场。
input.en: Enter through the matching Quick Assist prompt generated by Seth.

trigger.zh: 赛斯长普或支援突击已命中并触发简的提示；按当前狂热状态选对应支援招式。
trigger.en: Seth’s held Basic or Assist Follow-Up hit and generated Jane’s prompt. Use the assist matching her current Passion state.

complete.zh: 确认简真实快支入场并获得匪石之盾，再继续输出。
complete.en: Confirm Jane actually entered by Quick Assist and received the shield before continuing.

reason.zh: 非狂热为乌刺，狂热下为勾手跳；它们的起手状态不同，但同一次赛斯提示不能被普通换人替代。
reason.en: Normal-state entry is Dark Thorn; in Passion it is Lutz Jump. These differ by state, but an ordinary switch cannot replace Seth’s prompt.

fallback.zh: 未接成功就按实际状态恢复；盾仍在时不用为了重演开局反复上赛斯。
fallback.en: Recover from the actual state after a failed entry. Do not repeatedly bring Seth out when his shield remains active.

title.zh: 简留场积累狂热与强击
title.en: Jane: build Passion and Assault on field

input.zh: 普攻衔接可用攻击；遇真实攻击再做极限闪避和闪避反击。
input.en: Use Basic strings and available attacks. Perfect Dodge and counter actual incoming attacks.

trigger.zh: 露西加油和赛斯护盾按实际状态检查，目标可命中。
trigger.en: Check Lucy’s buff and Seth’s shield, and keep a hittable target.

complete.zh: 狂热和物理积蓄以游戏实际进度为准；优先在增益覆盖时造成强击。
complete.en: Read actual Passion and Physical buildup; aim to land Assault while the buffs cover it.

reason.zh: 本队以简持续站场为主，辅助需要续状态时再上场，不等待一个假定的固定失衡时间。
reason.en: Jane holds the field while supports refresh only as needed. Do not wait for an assumed fixed Stun timer.

fallback.zh: 增益失效先补对应辅助；没有狂热则先积累，不强行输入只在狂热可用的招式。
fallback.en: Refresh expired support effects. Outside Passion, build it rather than forcing Passion-only moves.

objective.zh: 简持续输出，按真实攻击决定是否招架合轴。
objective.en: Sustain Jane’s damage and use actual attacks to decide an assist overlap.

prep.zh: 露西加油或赛斯护盾到期才刷新；没有黄光就跳过招架链。
prep.en: Refresh Lucy’s buff or Seth’s shield when needed. Skip the parry chain if no cue appears.

title.zh: 简留场积累狂热与强击
title.en: Jane: build Passion and Assault on field

input.zh: 普攻衔接可用攻击；遇真实攻击再做极限闪避和闪避反击。
input.en: Use Basic strings and available attacks. Perfect Dodge and counter actual incoming attacks.

trigger.zh: 露西加油和赛斯护盾按实际状态检查，目标可命中。
trigger.en: Check Lucy’s buff and Seth’s shield, and keep a hittable target.

complete.zh: 狂热和物理积蓄以游戏实际进度为准；优先在增益覆盖时造成强击。
complete.en: Read actual Passion and Physical buildup; aim to land Assault while the buffs cover it.

reason.zh: 本队以简持续站场为主，辅助需要续状态时再上场，不等待一个假定的固定失衡时间。
reason.en: Jane holds the field while supports refresh only as needed. Do not wait for an assumed fixed Stun timer.

fallback.zh: 增益失效先补对应辅助；没有狂热则先积累，不强行输入只在狂热可用的招式。
fallback.en: Refresh expired support effects. Outside Passion, build it rather than forcing Passion-only moves.

title.zh: 狂热消耗后再用萨霍夫跳
title.en: Spend Passion before using Salchow Jump

input.zh: 确认有次数后长按普攻；需要提前收招时松开。
input.en: Hold Basic with a use available; release to finish early when needed.

trigger.zh: 处于狂热、有可用次数，且狂热心流已经消耗一部分。
trigger.en: In Passion, with a use available and some Passion Stream already spent.

complete.zh: 伤害实际命中才回复心流；观察终结一击。
complete.en: Actual hits restore Passion Stream; watch the finisher.

reason.zh: 先留出回复空间。作者的黄光招架衔接只适用于连续攻击阶段确实遇到可招架攻击。
reason.en: Leave room for recovery. The author’s Defensive Assist overlap applies only to a real parryable attack during the repeated hits.

fallback.zh: 没有黄光就完成当前招式继续简输出；无次数或无狂热回到普攻积累。
fallback.en: Without a parry cue, finish the move and continue Jane’s attacks. Without a use or Passion, return to building resources.

signal.zh: 仅连续攻击期间出现可招架黄光且有支援点时，招架切赛斯。
signal.en: Defensive Assist to Seth only on a parryable cue during the repeated attacks, with Assist Points available.

input.zh: 敌人可招架攻击到来时按对应支援键。
input.en: Press the matching Assist input when the parryable attack arrives.

trigger.zh: 简仍在萨霍夫跳连续攻击段，真实黄光可招架，支援点足够。
trigger.en: Jane is still performing Salchow Jump’s repeated attacks, an actual cue is parryable, and Assist Points are sufficient.

complete.zh: 赛斯确实触发招架支援，才进入支援突击分支。
complete.en: Only after Seth actually performs Defensive Assist, proceed to its follow-up.

reason.zh: 原作者说明此时简仍完成终结一击；只把仍未结束的这一击画为重叠，不扩展到后续整串动作。
reason.en: The author describes Jane finishing her attack after this handoff. Only that still-running finisher is shown as overlap, not the whole later sequence.

fallback.zh: 没有招架机会则跳过赛斯招架、突击及对应快支，继续简的常规输出。
fallback.en: Without the opportunity, skip this parry, follow-up and resulting Quick Assist; continue Jane’s normal damage cycle.

label.zh: 萨霍夫跳终结一击 · 尚未结束时
label.en: Salchow Jump finisher · while still running

title.zh: 招架后突击，提示简快支
title.en: After the parry, follow up to prompt Jane

input.zh: 成功招架支援后点按普通攻击。
input.en: Press Basic after a successful Defensive Assist.

trigger.zh: 上一事件已成功招架，支援突击当前可用。
trigger.en: The preceding parry succeeded and Assist Follow-Up is available.

complete.zh: 突击实际命中并出现上一位简的快支提示。
complete.en: The follow-up hits and prompts previous-slot Jane’s Quick Assist.

reason.zh: 这一支援链可以在没有强化特殊技能量时续简的护盾，但不代表已满足减积蓄抗性的长普末击条件。
reason.en: This assist chain can refresh Jane’s shield without EX energy, but does not imply the held-Basic finisher’s buildup-RES debuff occurred.

fallback.zh: 没有命中或提示则不强行接简；需减积蓄抗性时另按资源完成赛斯长普末击。
fallback.en: Without a hit or prompt, do not force Jane’s entry. Apply the held-Basic finisher separately when its debuff is needed and resources permit.

signal.en: Quick Assist back to Jane using the actual prompt.

title.zh: 简快支入场，检查匪石之盾
title.en: Jane Quick Assist: verify Shield of Firm Resolve

input.zh: 按赛斯触发的对应快速支援提示入场。
input.en: Enter through the matching Quick Assist prompt generated by Seth.

trigger.zh: 赛斯长普或支援突击已命中并触发简的提示；按当前狂热状态选对应支援招式。
trigger.en: Seth’s held Basic or Assist Follow-Up hit and generated Jane’s prompt. Use the assist matching her current Passion state.

complete.zh: 确认简真实快支入场并获得匪石之盾，再继续输出。
complete.en: Confirm Jane actually entered by Quick Assist and received the shield before continuing.

reason.zh: 非狂热为乌刺，狂热下为勾手跳；它们的起手状态不同，但同一次赛斯提示不能被普通换人替代。
reason.en: Normal-state entry is Dark Thorn; in Passion it is Lutz Jump. These differ by state, but an ordinary switch cannot replace Seth’s prompt.

fallback.zh: 未接成功就按实际状态恢复；盾仍在时不用为了重演开局反复上赛斯。
fallback.en: Recover from the actual state after a failed entry. Do not repeatedly bring Seth out when his shield remains active.

objective.zh: 增益覆盖下集中输出，并利用终结技恢复狂热。
objective.en: Concentrate damage under buffs and use the Ultimate to restore Passion.

prep.zh: 窗口前确认加油与匪石之盾；缺失时先回准备阶段。
prep.en: Confirm Cheer On and Shield of Firm Resolve before the window; return to setup if missing.

title.zh: 有输出机会时用终结技恢复狂热
title.en: Use a ready Ultimate in a real damage opportunity

input.zh: 终结技就绪时点按终结技。

trigger.zh: 技能已就绪、目标可命中且增益覆盖；狂热较低时能更好利用回满效果。
trigger.en: Ultimate ready, target hittable and buffs active; low Passion better uses the refill.

complete.zh: 发动时直接进入狂热并回满心流；确认攻击命中后按当前资源继续。
complete.en: Activation enters Passion and refills Passion Stream; confirm the attack lands before continuing with the current resources.

reason.zh: 不要求等失衡；若真实失衡窗口出现可集中输出。旧1.1攻略的全队共享终结技能量前提不沿用。
reason.en: Stun is not mandatory, though a real Stun window can concentrate damage. The old 1.1 shared-Ultimate-resource premise is not reused.

fallback.zh: 未就绪或目标不可命中时跳过，继续普攻与狂热循环。
fallback.en: If unavailable or the target cannot be hit, skip and continue the Basic/Passion loop.

title.zh: 资源允许再补强化特殊技
title.en: Add EX Special when resources permit

input.zh: 有能量时点按强化特殊技。
input.en: Press EX Special with sufficient energy.

trigger.zh: 能量足够且目标处于可命中窗口。
trigger.en: Enough energy and a hittable target.

complete.zh: 完成连续踢击和横扫，检查实际物理积蓄和狂热。
complete.en: Complete the kicks and sweep, then check actual Physical buildup and Passion.

reason.zh: 这里补充异常积蓄，不假定单次强化特殊技必然触发强击。
reason.en: This adds buildup; one EX is not assumed to guarantee Assault.

fallback.zh: 没有能量就跳过，不用普通特殊技伪装成强化分支。
fallback.en: Skip without energy; normal Special does not replace this EX branch.

title.zh: 简留场积累狂热与强击
title.en: Jane: build Passion and Assault on field

input.zh: 普攻衔接可用攻击；遇真实攻击再做极限闪避和闪避反击。
input.en: Use Basic strings and available attacks. Perfect Dodge and counter actual incoming attacks.

trigger.zh: 露西加油和赛斯护盾按实际状态检查，目标可命中。
trigger.en: Check Lucy’s buff and Seth’s shield, and keep a hittable target.

complete.zh: 狂热和物理积蓄以游戏实际进度为准；优先在增益覆盖时造成强击。
complete.en: Read actual Passion and Physical buildup; aim to land Assault while the buffs cover it.

reason.zh: 本队以简持续站场为主，辅助需要续状态时再上场，不等待一个假定的固定失衡时间。
reason.en: Jane holds the field while supports refresh only as needed. Do not wait for an assumed fixed Stun timer.

fallback.zh: 增益失效先补对应辅助；没有狂热则先积累，不强行输入只在狂热可用的招式。
fallback.en: Refresh expired support effects. Outside Passion, build it rather than forcing Passion-only moves.

title.zh: 狂热消耗后再用萨霍夫跳
title.en: Spend Passion before using Salchow Jump

input.zh: 确认有次数后长按普攻；需要提前收招时松开。
input.en: Hold Basic with a use available; release to finish early when needed.

trigger.zh: 处于狂热、有可用次数，且狂热心流已经消耗一部分。
trigger.en: In Passion, with a use available and some Passion Stream already spent.

complete.zh: 伤害实际命中才回复心流；观察终结一击。
complete.en: Actual hits restore Passion Stream; watch the finisher.

reason.zh: 先留出回复空间。作者的黄光招架衔接只适用于连续攻击阶段确实遇到可招架攻击。
reason.en: Leave room for recovery. The author’s Defensive Assist overlap applies only to a real parryable attack during the repeated hits.

fallback.zh: 没有黄光就完成当前招式继续简输出；无次数或无狂热回到普攻积累。
fallback.en: Without a parry cue, finish the move and continue Jane’s attacks. Without a use or Passion, return to building resources.

text.zh: 赛斯2影开局已有75%意气时，可跳过开局补意气的EX；这份赠送不每轮重复。
text.en: With Seth M2’s opening 75% Resolve still available, skip the setup EX. The grant does not repeat each cycle.

text.zh: 简1影增加萨霍夫跳可用次数上限，仍按当前次数和狂热状态决定，不能无限循环长普。
text.en: Jane M1 increases the Salchow use cap; check remaining uses and Passion, rather than repeating it without limit.

text.zh: 简6影的强击触发可直接回满狂热；按实际状态跳过已经不需要的回条动作。
text.en: Jane M6 can refill Passion on Assault; skip recovery that is no longer needed.

text.zh: 露西6影在加油期间由队友EX命中延长状态，但有次数和时长上限；看实际状态再刷新。
text.en: Lucy M6 can extend Cheer On through teammate EX hits, with count and duration caps; refresh according to the real state.

text.zh: 简专武的猎意依靠接战／极限闪避或冲刺攻击触发；不是选上专武就永久满层。
text.en: Jane’s signature stacks require combat entry, Perfect Dodge or Dash Attacks; equipping it does not permanently guarantee full stacks.

ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.露西先建立加油: 按强化特殊技给全队加攻
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.赛斯补足意气: 长按强化特殊技给赛斯补意气
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.简快支入场，检查匪石之盾: 看到简的快支提示再入场
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.狂热消耗后再用萨霍夫跳: 狂热且有次数时长按普攻
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.可选：黄光招架接赛斯: 可选：黄光可招架时切赛斯
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.有输出机会时用终结技恢复狂热: 终结技就绪时恢复狂热
ROTATION_LESSON_TITLES.资源允许再补强化特殊技: 能量够时补强化特殊技

ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.普攻衔接可用攻击；遇真实攻击再做极限闪避和闪避反击。: 点按普攻积攒狂热。遇到攻击，先闪避；成功极限闪避后再按普攻反击。
ROTATION_LESSON_INPUTS.确认有次数后长按普攻；需要提前收招时松开。: 狂热状态且还有可用次数时，长按普攻。要提前收招就松开。

ROTATION_RECOVERY_INPUTS.1261: 需要狂热时点按普攻命中积攒，进入狂热且有次数才长按普攻。

ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.115100005: 能量足够时按强化特殊技，等小猪爆炸并命中
ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.127100002: 意气达到75%时长按普攻，等最后一击命中
ROTATION_ADAPTED_INPUTS.127100014: 成功招架后点按普攻，等突击和两次横扫完成

126100001: 本步用普攻命中积狂热；没有指定必须打到第几段。反击只在极限闪避后点普攻。
Land Basics for Passion here, with no fixed hit count. For a Dodge Counter, tap Basic after a Perfect Dodge.
126100004: 有狂热和可用次数才长按普攻；松开可提前收尾，不需点到某一普攻段数。
Hold Basic with Passion and a charge available; release to finish early. No numbered Basic lead-in.
127100002: 意气达到75%后长按普攻发动，本路线要等最后一击；不是先打满普攻连段。
